purpose: Qualified references for a small RISC-V MCU; no cross-process or unmatched-scope superiority ratios.

limitations: Official HTTP URL linked by Croc README; HTTPS certificate name mismatch, no TLS verification bypass used.
The gallery does not provide a comparable activity-based or measured power result.
Derived physical design reference capacity is six times the local baseline; do not attribute die-area difference to optimization.
Maintainer report of upstream silicon does not validate this repository's modified/frozen implementation.

sources.title: Croc: An End-to-End Open-Source Extensible RISC-V MCU Platform to Democratize Silicon
limitations: Use the authors' typical-condition qualification; this is not an all-corner Fmax guarantee for the local design.
CPU-core area, not SoC or die area.
CoreMark measured on the Ibex Simple System platform; local CoreMark has not been reproduced.
Commercial area is explicitly a rough estimate.
This open synthesis reference is not a silicon node comparison or a SG13G2 mapping; do not convert its kGE directly to local mm2.

local_physical_boundary_evidence.interpretation: Same archived layout, newly verified sealed bounding-box scope; not an area improvement. Different SRAM/peripherals and outline definitions still prevent a superiority ratio vs MLEM.
